name: Dazai Mei
source:
[i]"Kidnapping us, bringing us to this weird world, and imprisoning us isn't exactly my idea of fair."[/i]

Although he may seem distant, he is very kind at heart. Vigilant and watchful, he keeps the free spirits in the group grounded. He loves cats. 

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/chara/?page=ch4]Idea Factory International[/url]]
